```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set theme
custom_theme <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

convert_detected <- function(x) {
  # Check if it's a numeric CT value (detected with CT)
  if (is.character(x) && !is.na(x) && grepl("^[0-9.]+$", x)) {
    return(as.numeric(x))  # CT value is a positive number
  }
  
  # Check for text values
  if (is.character(x)) {
    lower_x <- str_to_lower(x)
    if (lower_x == "detected") {
      return(1)  # Detected but no CT value
    } else if (lower_x == "not detected") {
      return(0)  # Not detected
    } else if (lower_x == "unknown" || is.na(x)) {
      return(NA_real_)  # Not tested (now "NA")
    }
  }
  
  # If already numeric (shouldn't happen with new format, but just in case)
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  
  # Default
  return(NA_real_)
}

process_pcr_file_with_ct <- function(pcr_file, dataset_name) {
  # Read the PCR file
  pcr_raw <- read_excel(pcr_file)
  
  # Get all pathogen columns (everything except sample_id)
  pathogen_cols <- setdiff(names(pcr_raw), "sample_id")
  
  # Process each column
  result_list <- list()
  
  for (col in pathogen_cols) {
    col_data <- pcr_raw[[col]]
    
    for (i in seq_along(col_data)) {
      sample_id <- pcr_raw$sample_id[i]
      value <- col_data[i]
      
      # Determine PCR result and CT value
      if (is.character(value) && !is.na(value)) {
        lower_val <- str_to_lower(value)
        
        if (lower_val == "detected") {
          # Detected but no CT value
          result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            sample_id = sample_id,
            Pathogen = col,
            PCR_Result = 1,
            ct_values = NA_real_,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        } else if (lower_val == "not detected") {
          result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            sample_id = sample_id,
            Pathogen = col,
            PCR_Result = 0,
            ct_values = NA_real_,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        } else if (lower_val == "unknown" || is.na(value)) {
          result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            sample_id = sample_id,
            Pathogen = col,
            PCR_Result = NA_real_,
            ct_values = NA_real_,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        } else if (grepl("^[0-9.]+$", lower_val)) {
          # This is a CT value (detected with CT)
          ct_val <- as.numeric(lower_val)
          result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            sample_id = sample_id,
            Pathogen = col,
            PCR_Result = 1,  # Positive
            ct_values = ct_val,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
      } else if (is.numeric(value) && !is.na(value)) {
        # This is a CT value (numeric)
        result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          sample_id = sample_id,
          Pathogen = col,
          PCR_Result = 1,  # Positive
          ct_values = value,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      } else if (is.na(value)) {
        result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          sample_id = sample_id,
          Pathogen = col,
          PCR_Result = NA_real_,
          ct_values = NA_real_,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  result_df <- bind_rows(result_list) %>%
    mutate(original_dataset = dataset_name)
  
  return(result_df)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Modified prepare_dataset function with combination logic for ALL datasets
prepare_dataset <- function(dataset_config) {
  
  # Check if this is a combined dataset
  if (dataset_config$name == "ALL_COMBINED") {
    
    pcr_list <- list()
    continuous_list <- list()
    
    # List of individual dataset names (excluding ALL_COMBINED itself)
    individual_datasets <- c("PathCare", "NHLS_GS", "NHLS_TY", "Mucokids", "SUDI")
    
    for (ds_name in individual_datasets) {
      # Find the dataset configuration
      ds_config <- list(
        name = ds_name,
        pcr_file = datasets[[which(sapply(datasets, function(x) x$name == ds_name))]]$pcr_file,
        continuous_file = datasets[[which(sapply(datasets, function(x) x$name == ds_name))]]$continuous_file
      )
      
      # Process PCR file with CT values
      pcr_list[[ds_name]] <- process_pcr_file_with_ct(ds_config$pcr_file, ds_name)
      
      # Continuous data - NO CT VALUES ANYMORE
      continuous_list[[ds_name]] <- read_csv(ds_config$continuous_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        select(sample_id, Pathogen, coverage_percentage, rpm, 
               depth_of_coverage, viral_loads, Contam) %>%
        mutate(across(c(coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, viral_loads), as.numeric),
               Contam = ifelse(is.na(Contam), "NO", toupper(Contam))) %>%
        mutate(original_dataset = ds_name)
    }
    
    # Combine all PCR data
    pcr_data <- bind_rows(pcr_list)
    
    # Combine all continuous data
    continuous_data <- bind_rows(continuous_list)
    
  } else {
    # Original loading for non-combined datasets
    pcr_data <- process_pcr_file_with_ct(dataset_config$pcr_file, dataset_config$name)
    
    continuous_data <- read_csv(dataset_config$continuous_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, coverage_percentage, rpm, 
             depth_of_coverage, viral_loads, Contam) %>%
      mutate(across(c(coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, viral_loads), as.numeric),
             Contam = ifelse(is.na(Contam), "NO", toupper(Contam)))
  }
  
  # Get all unique samples and pathogens
  all_samples <- unique(continuous_data$sample_id)
  all_pathogens <- unique(continuous_data$Pathogen)
  
  # Create complete grid of all combinations
  complete_df <- expand_grid(sample_id = all_samples, Pathogen = all_pathogens)
  
  # Join with original data and fill missing values
  continuous_data_complete <- complete_df %>%
    left_join(continuous_data, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    mutate(
      rpm = replace_na(rpm, 0),
      coverage_percentage = replace_na(coverage_percentage, 0),
      depth_of_coverage = replace_na(depth_of_coverage, 0),
      viral_loads = replace_na(viral_loads, 0),
      Contam = replace_na(Contam, "NO")
    )
  
  # Add original_dataset column if it doesn't exist (for non-combined datasets)
  if (!"original_dataset" %in% names(continuous_data_complete)) {
    continuous_data_complete <- continuous_data_complete %>%
      mutate(original_dataset = dataset_config$name)
  }
  
  list(
    name = dataset_config$name,
    description = dataset_config$description,
    pcr = pcr_data,
    continuous = continuous_data_complete
  )
}

datasets <- lapply(datasets, function(df) {
  df$rpm <- as.numeric(df$rpm)
  df
})

loaded_datasets <- map(datasets, prepare_dataset)
names(loaded_datasets) <- map_chr(datasets, ~.x$name)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

# Enhanced analysis functions with contamination adjustment
analyze_thresholds <- function(dataset, metric_type, thresholds) {
  if (!all(c("pcr", "continuous") %in% names(dataset))) {
    return(list(results = NULL, results_contam = NULL, 
                fn_samples = list(), fp_samples = list()))
  }
  
  merged_data <- dataset$pcr %>%
    left_join(dataset$continuous, by = c("sample_id","Pathogen"))
  
  results <- list()
  results_contam <- list()  # For contamination-adjusted results
  fn_samples <- list()
  fp_samples <- list()
  
  for (threshold in thresholds) {
    threshold_label <- paste0(metric_type, threshold)
    
    # Calculate SEQ_Result based on metric type
    seq_data <- merged_data %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = case_when(
        metric_type == "cov" ~ ifelse(coverage_percentage >= threshold, 1, 0),
        metric_type == "rpm" ~ ifelse(rpm >= threshold, 1, 0),
        metric_type == "depth" ~ ifelse(depth_of_coverage >= threshold, 1, 0),
        TRUE ~ 0
      ))
    
    analysis_data <- seq_data %>% filter(!is.na(PCR_Result))
    
    # Original confusion matrix
    TP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Contamination-adjusted confusion matrix
    TP_contam <- TP
    TN_contam <- TN
    FP_contam <- FP
    FN_contam <- FN
    
    # Adjust for contamination: if Contam == "YES", change FP to TN and TP to FN
    contamination_adjustments <- seq_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(PCR_Result) & Contam == "YES") %>%
      summarise(
        FP_to_TN = sum(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        TP_to_FN = sum(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    
    FP_contam <- FP - contamination_adjustments$FP_to_TN
    TN_contam <- TN + contamination_adjustments$FP_to_TN
    TP_contam <- TP - contamination_adjustments$TP_to_FN
    FN_contam <- FN + contamination_adjustments$TP_to_FN
    
    # Calculate metrics
    sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
    specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
    
    sensitivity_contam <- ifelse((TP_contam + FN_contam) > 0, 
                                 TP_contam / (TP_contam + FN_contam), NA_real_)
    specificity_contam <- ifelse((TN_contam + FP_contam) > 0, 
                                 TN_contam / (TN_contam + FP_contam), NA_real_)
    
    results[[threshold_label]] <- tibble(
      Threshold = threshold_label,
      TP = TP, FN = FN, FP = FP, TN = TN,
      Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
      Specificity = round(specificity, 3),
      PPV = ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, round(TP / (TP + FP), 3), NA_real_),
      NPV = ifelse((TN + FN) > 0, round(TN / (TN + FN), 3), NA_real_),
      Not_Tested = sum(is.na(seq_data$PCR_Result), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    results_contam[[threshold_label]] <- tibble(
      Threshold = threshold_label,
      TP = TP_contam, FN = FN_contam, FP = FP_contam, TN = TN_contam,
      Sensitivity = round(sensitivity_contam, 3),
      Specificity = round(specificity_contam, 3),
      PPV = ifelse((TP_contam + FP_contam) > 0, 
                   round(TP_contam / (TP_contam + FP_contam), 3), NA_real_),
      NPV = ifelse((TN_contam + FN_contam) > 0, 
                   round(TN_contam / (TN_contam + FN_contam), 3), NA_real_),
      Not_Tested = sum(is.na(seq_data$PCR_Result), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    # Sample-level analysis
    fn_samples[[threshold_label]] <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result == 0) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
             coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values, Contam)
    
    fp_samples[[threshold_label]] <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result == 1) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
             coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values, Contam)
  }
  
  list(
    results = bind_rows(results),
    results_contam = bind_rows(results_contam),
    fn_samples = fn_samples,
    fp_samples = fp_samples
  )
}

# Replace the display_contam_adjusted_confusion function with this improved version
display_contam_adjusted_confusion <- function(dataset_name) {
  ds <- loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]]
  if (is.null(ds)) {
    cat("Dataset not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get coverage results
  cov_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]$coverage
  rpm_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]$rpm
  depth_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]$depth
  
  # Create tables for each metric type
  create_metric_table <- function(results, metric_name) {
    if (is.null(results$results_contam) || nrow(results$results_contam) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Extract original and contam-adjusted results
    orig <- results$results %>%
      select(Threshold, TP, TN, FP, FN, Sensitivity, Specificity) %>%
      mutate(Type = "Original")
    
    contam <- results$results_contam %>%
      select(Threshold, TP, TN, FP, FN, Sensitivity, Specificity) %>%
      mutate(Type = "Contam-Adjusted")
    
    # Combine and format
    combined <- bind_rows(orig, contam) %>%
      mutate(
        TP = as.integer(TP),
        TN = as.integer(TN),
        FP = as.integer(FP),
        FN = as.integer(FN),
        Total = TP + TN + FP + FN,
        Sensitivity = round(Sensitivity * 100, 1),
        Specificity = round(Specificity * 100, 1)
      ) %>%
      select(Threshold, Type, TP, TN, FP, FN, Total, Sensitivity, Specificity)
    
    return(combined)
  }
  
  # Create and display tables with improved headers
  cat("\n#### Coverage Thresholds\n\n")
  cat("*Confusion matrices showing Original vs Contamination-Adjusted results*\n\n")
  cov_table <- create_metric_table(cov_results, "Coverage")
  if (!is.null(cov_table)) {
    print(kable(cov_table, 
                caption = paste("Confusion Matrix -", dataset_name, "(Coverage Thresholds)"),
                format = "html",
                col.names = c("Threshold", "Type", "TP", "TN", "FP", "FN", "Total", "Sensitivity %", "Specificity %")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            row_spec(which(cov_table$Type == "Contam-Adjusted"), background = "#FFF3CD") %>%
            add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Confusion Matrix" = 4, " " = 1, "Performance Metrics" = 2)))
  }
  
  cat("\n#### RPM Thresholds\n\n")
  cat("*Confusion matrices showing Original vs Contamination-Adjusted results*\n\n")
  rpm_table <- create_metric_table(rpm_results, "RPM")
  if (!is.null(rpm_table)) {
    print(kable(rpm_table,
                caption = paste("Confusion Matrix -", dataset_name, "(RPM Thresholds)"),
                format = "html",
                col.names = c("Threshold", "Type", "TP", "TN", "FP", "FN", "Total", "Sensitivity %", "Specificity %")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            row_spec(which(rpm_table$Type == "Contam-Adjusted"), background = "#FFF3CD") %>%
            add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Confusion Matrix" = 4, " " = 1, "Performance Metrics" = 2)))
  }
  
  cat("\n#### Depth Thresholds\n\n")
  cat("*Confusion matrices showing Original vs Contamination-Adjusted results*\n\n")
  depth_table <- create_metric_table(depth_results, "Depth")
  if (!is.null(depth_table)) {
    print(kable(depth_table,
                caption = paste("Confusion Matrix -", dataset_name, "(Depth Thresholds)"),
                format = "html",
                col.names = c("Threshold", "Type", "TP", "TN", "FP", "FN", "Total", "Sensitivity %", "Specificity %")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            row_spec(which(depth_table$Type == "Contam-Adjusted"), background = "#FFF3CD") %>%
            add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Confusion Matrix" = 4, " " = 1, "Performance Metrics" = 2)))
  }
}

# Function to calculate 95% CI for sensitivity and specificity
calculate_ci_contam <- function(dataset_name, metric_type = "coverage") {
  ds <- loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]]
  if (is.null(ds)) {
    cat("Dataset not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get results based on metric type
  if (metric_type == "coverage") {
    results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]$coverage$results_contam
  } else if (metric_type == "rpm") {
    results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]$rpm$results_contam
  } else if (metric_type == "depth") {
    results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]$depth$results_contam
  } else {
    cat("Invalid metric_type. Use 'coverage', 'rpm', or 'depth'\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(results) || nrow(results) == 0) {
    cat("No results found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate 95% CI using Wilson score interval
  calc_wilson_ci <- function(x, n, conf_level = 0.95) {
    if (n == 0) return(c(NA, NA))
    z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - conf_level)/2)
    p <- x/n
    # Wilson score interval
    denominator <- 1 + z^2/n
    centre <- (p + z^2/(2*n)) / denominator
    spread <- z * sqrt((p*(1-p)/n) + z^2/(4*n^2)) / denominator
    return(c(max(0, centre - spread), min(1, centre + spread)))
  }
  
  # Add CI columns
  results_with_ci <- results %>%
    mutate(
      Total = TP + TN + FP + FN,
      # Sensitivity CI
      Sens_CI_Lower = map2_dbl(TP, TP + FN, ~calc_wilson_ci(.x, .y)[1]),
      Sens_CI_Upper = map2_dbl(TP, TP + FN, ~calc_wilson_ci(.x, .y)[2]),
      # Specificity CI
      Spec_CI_Lower = map2_dbl(TN, TN + FP, ~calc_wilson_ci(.x, .y)[1]),
      Spec_CI_Upper = map2_dbl(TN, TN + FP, ~calc_wilson_ci(.x, .y)[2]),
      # Format for display
      Sensitivity_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%-%.1f%%)", 
                               Sensitivity * 100,
                               Sens_CI_Lower * 100,
                               Sens_CI_Upper * 100),
      Specificity_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%-%.1f%%)", 
                               Specificity * 100,
                               Spec_CI_Lower * 100,
                               Spec_CI_Upper * 100)
    ) %>%
    select(Threshold, TP, FN, FP, TN, Total, 
           Sensitivity_CI, Specificity_CI)
  
  return(results_with_ci)
}

# Function to get contamination-adjusted FP and FN samples
get_contamination_adjusted_fp_fn <- function(dataset, metric_type = "cov", threshold = 10) {
  if (!all(c("pcr", "continuous") %in% names(dataset))) {
    return(list(fp_samples = NULL, fn_samples = NULL))
  }
  
  merged_data <- inner_join(dataset$pcr, dataset$continuous, 
                          by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result))  # Remove "Not tested"
  
  # Calculate SEQ_Result based on metric type
  seq_data <- merged_data %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result = case_when(
      metric_type == "cov" ~ ifelse(coverage_percentage >= threshold, 1, 0),
      metric_type == "rpm" ~ ifelse(rpm >= threshold, 1, 0),
      metric_type == "depth" ~ ifelse(depth_of_coverage >= threshold, 1, 0),
      TRUE ~ 0
    ))
  
  # Calculate contamination-adjusted results
  # For contamination samples: SEQ_Result becomes 0 regardless of threshold
  seq_data_contam <- seq_data %>%
    mutate(
      SEQ_Result_Adjusted = case_when(
        Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ SEQ_Result
      )
    )
  
  # Get contamination-adjusted FP (PCR=0, SEQ_Adjusted=1)
  fp_contam <- seq_data_contam %>%
    filter(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result_Adjusted == 1) %>%
    select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, SEQ_Result_Adjusted,
           coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values, Contam) %>%
    mutate(
      Error_Type = "False Positive",
      Adjustment = as.character(ifelse(SEQ_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result_Adjusted == 0, 
                              "Corrected (Contamination)", "Unchanged"))
    )
  
  # Get contamination-adjusted FN (PCR=1, SEQ_Adjusted=0)
  fn_contam <- seq_data_contam %>%
    filter(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result_Adjusted == 0) %>%
    select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, SEQ_Result_Adjusted,
           coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values, Contam) %>%
    mutate(
      Error_Type = "False Negative",
      Adjustment = as.character(ifelse(SEQ_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result_Adjusted == 0, 
                              "Corrected (Contamination)", "Unchanged"))
    )
  
  # Combine and add metadata
  all_errors <- bind_rows(fp_contam, fn_contam) %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = paste0(metric_type, "=", threshold),
      Dataset = dataset$name,
      .before = 1
    ) %>%
    arrange(Error_Type, sample_id)
  
  # Create summary statistics
  summary_stats <- all_errors %>%
    group_by(Error_Type, Adjustment) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  list(
    all_errors = all_errors,
    fp_samples = fp_contam,
    fn_samples = fn_contam,
    summary = summary_stats
  )
}

# Wrapper functions for specific metric types
analyze_coverage <- function(dataset) {
  analyze_thresholds(dataset, "cov", c(10, 20, 50, 80, 90))
}

analyze_rpm <- function(dataset) {
  analyze_thresholds(dataset, "rpm", c(1, 10, 100, 1000))
}

analyze_depth <- function(dataset) {
  analyze_thresholds(dataset, "depth", c(10, 30))
}

generate_roc <- function(dataset) {
  if (!all(c("pcr", "continuous") %in% names(dataset))) {
    return(list(performance = tibble(Metric = character(), AUC = numeric())))
  }
  
  roc_data <- inner_join(dataset$pcr, dataset$continuous, 
                        by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result)) %>%  # Exclude "Not tested"
    drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(roc_data) == 0 || length(unique(roc_data$PCR_Result)) != 2) {
    return(list(performance = tibble(Metric = character(), AUC = numeric())))
  }
  
  roc_coverage <- try(roc(PCR_Result ~ coverage_percentage, data = roc_data), silent = TRUE)
  roc_rpm <- try(roc(PCR_Result ~ rpm, data = roc_data), silent = TRUE)
  roc_depth <- try(roc(PCR_Result ~ depth_of_coverage, data = roc_data), silent = TRUE)
  
  performance <- tibble(
    Metric = c("Coverage", "RPM", "Depth"),
    AUC = c(
      if (!inherits(roc_coverage, "try-error")) auc(roc_coverage) else NA_real_,
      if (!inherits(roc_rpm, "try-error")) auc(roc_rpm) else NA_real_,
      if (!inherits(roc_depth, "try-error")) auc(roc_depth) else NA_real_
    )
  )
  
  list(
    roc_data = roc_data,
    roc_objects = list(coverage = roc_coverage, rpm = roc_rpm, depth = roc_depth),
    performance = performance
  )
}


# Function to create contamination-adjusted performance plots
create_contamination_plots <- function(dataset_name, metric_type = "coverage") {
  ds_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]
  
  if (is.null(ds_results)) return(NULL)
  
  # Get the appropriate results based on metric type
  if (metric_type == "coverage") {
    orig_results <- ds_results$coverage$results
    contam_results <- ds_results$coverage$results_contam
    thresholds <- orig_results$Threshold
  } else if (metric_type == "rpm") {
    orig_results <- ds_results$rpm$results
    contam_results <- ds_results$rpm$results_contam
    thresholds <- orig_results$Threshold
  } else if (metric_type == "depth") {
    orig_results <- ds_results$depth$results
    contam_results <- ds_results$depth$results_contam
    thresholds <- orig_results$Threshold
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(orig_results) || is.null(contam_results)) return(NULL)
  
  # Combine original and contamination-adjusted results
  combined_data <- bind_rows(
    orig_results %>% mutate(Group = "Original"),
    contam_results %>% mutate(Group = "Contamination-Adjusted")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Threshold_Value = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Threshold)))
  
  # Create plots for each metric
  metrics <- c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FN", "FP", "TN")
  
  plots <- list()
  
  for (metric in metrics) {
    p <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Threshold_Value, y = .data[[metric]], 
                                    color = Group, group = Group)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.5) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      labs(title = paste(metric, "vs", metric_type, "Threshold"),
           x = paste(metric_type, "Threshold"),
           y = metric,
           color = "Group") +
      custom_theme() +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "#1F77B4", 
                                    "Contamination-Adjusted" = "red")) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    
    plots[[metric]] <- p
  }
  
  # Arrange plots
  combined_plot <- (plots[["Sensitivity"]] + plots[["Specificity"]]) / 
                   (plots[["TP"]] + plots[["FN"]]) /
                   (plots[["FP"]] + plots[["TN"]]) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# Function to create combined plot with A, B, C labels (vertical arrangement)
create_combined_faceted_plot <- function() {
  library(patchwork)
  
  plots <- list()
  labels <- c("A.", "B.", "C.")
  dataset_names <- c("PathCare", "NHLS_GS", "NHLS_TY", "Mucokids", "SUDI" )
  
  # Create individual plots WITHOUT legends
  for (i in seq_along(dataset_names)) {
    ds_name <- dataset_names[i]
    if (ds_name %in% names(loaded_datasets)) {
      p <- create_faceted_ct_plot(ds_name)
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        # Extract plot data to get all pathogens
        plot_data <- p$data
        
        # Remove legend from individual plots
        plots[[i]] <- p + 
          labs(subtitle = paste0(labels[i]),
               x = "Depth of coverage",
               y = "Genome coverage (%)") +
          theme(
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0, 
                                        margin = margin(b = 5, t = 5)),
            legend.position = "none",  # Remove individual legends
            axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
            strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
          )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Remove NULL plots
  plots <- plots[!sapply(plots, is.null)]
  
  if (length(plots) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Create a common legend
  # Get data from first plot to extract pathogens
  first_plot_data <- plots[[1]]$data
  all_pathogens <- unique(first_plot_data$Pathogen)
  
  # Create a dummy plot just for the legend using Dark2 palette
  dummy_plot <- ggplot(first_plot_data, aes(x = depth_of_coverage, y = coverage_percentage, 
                                          color = Pathogen)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Dark2",
    name = "Pathogen",
    guide = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2,        # 2 columns
      byrow = TRUE,    # fill by row
      override.aes = list(size = 5), # point size in legend
      keywidth = 1,    # remove extra space
      keyheight = 1
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key = element_blank(),  # remove box around colors
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm")
  )
  
  # Extract legend
  common_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(dummy_plot)
  
  # Combine plots vertically
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1, heights = rep(1, length(plots))) &
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  # Add common legend at the bottom
  final_plot <- combined_plot / 
    plot_spacer() /  # Small spacer
    common_legend +
    plot_layout(
      ncol = 1,
      heights = c(rep(1, length(plots)), 0.1, 0.2)  # Adjust heights for plots, spacer, legend
    )
  
  return(final_plot)
}

# Also update the create_faceted_ct_plot function to use Dark2 palette
create_faceted_ct_plot <- function(dataset_name) {
  ds <- loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]]
  
  if (is.null(ds)) return(NULL)
  
  PathCare_data <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                          by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ct_values) & ct_values > 0) %>%
    mutate(Ct_bin = cut(ct_values, breaks = c(-Inf, 20, 30, Inf),
                        labels = c("Ct <20", "Ct 20–30", "Ct >30")))
  
  library(scales)
  
  # Get unique pathogens in this dataset
  dataset_pathogens <- unique(PathCare_data$Pathogen)
  
  facet_ct <- ggplot(PathCare_data, aes(x = depth_of_coverage, y = coverage_percentage,
                                     color = Pathogen)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~Ct_bin) +
    labs(title = NULL,
         x = "Depth of coverage",
         y = "Genome coverage (%)") +
    custom_theme(base_size = 14) +  # Increased base size
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +  # Use Dark2 palette
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, ),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
  
  return(facet_ct)
}

create_contamination_performance_heatmap <- function(dataset_name, save_plot = TRUE) {
  ds <- loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]]
  if (is.null(ds)) {
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = paste("No dataset:", dataset_name)))
  }
  
  # Prepare data - ALL samples
  merged_data <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, 
                          by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result))  # Remove "Not tested"
  
  # Define thresholds
  coverage_thresholds <- c(0, 1, 10, 20, 50, 80, 90)
  
  # Calculate performance for each combination
  results <- tibble()
  
  for (cov_thresh in coverage_thresholds) {
    # LAYER 1: What if we IGNORE the Contam column (no contamination filtering)
    data_layer1 <- merged_data %>%
      mutate(
        SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= cov_thresh, 1, 0)
      )
    
    # Confusion matrix for layer 1
    TP1 <- sum(data_layer1$PCR_Result == 1 & data_layer1$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN1 <- sum(data_layer1$PCR_Result == 0 & data_layer1$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP1 <- sum(data_layer1$PCR_Result == 0 & data_layer1$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN1 <- sum(data_layer1$PCR_Result == 1 & data_layer1$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate metrics for layer 1
    sensitivity1 <- ifelse((TP1 + FN1) > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FN1), NA)
    specificity1 <- ifelse((TN1 + FP1) > 0, TN1 / (TN1 + FP1), NA)
    accuracy1 <- ifelse((TP1 + TN1 + FP1 + FN1) > 0, 
                       (TP1 + TN1) / (TP1 + TN1 + FP1 + FN1), NA)
    precision1 <- ifelse((TP1 + FP1) > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FP1), NA)
    f1_score1 <- ifelse((precision1 + sensitivity1) > 0, 
                        2 * (precision1 * sensitivity1) / (precision1 + sensitivity1), NA)
    
    # LAYER 2: Current reality - Contam column ALREADY reflects contamination filtering
    data_layer2 <- merged_data %>%
      mutate(
        SEQ_Result = case_when(
          Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
          coverage_percentage >= cov_thresh ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )
      )
    
    # Confusion matrix for layer 2
    TP2 <- sum(data_layer2$PCR_Result == 1 & data_layer2$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN2 <- sum(data_layer2$PCR_Result == 0 & data_layer2$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP2 <- sum(data_layer2$PCR_Result == 0 & data_layer2$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN2 <- sum(data_layer2$PCR_Result == 1 & data_layer2$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate metrics for layer 2
    sensitivity2 <- ifelse((TP2 + FN2) > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FN2), NA)
    specificity2 <- ifelse((TN2 + FP2) > 0, TN2 / (TN2 + FP2), NA)
    accuracy2 <- ifelse((TP2 + TN2 + FP2 + FN2) > 0, 
                       (TP2 + TN2) / (TP2 + TN2 + FP2 + FN2), NA)
    precision2 <- ifelse((TP2 + FP2) > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FP2), NA)
    f1_score2 <- ifelse((precision2 + sensitivity2) > 0, 
                        2 * (precision2 * sensitivity2) / (precision2 + sensitivity2), NA)
    
    # Count how many samples are contaminated
    contaminated_samples <- sum(merged_data$Contam == "YES", na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Count how many would change if we ignored contamination
    would_change <- merged_data %>%
      mutate(
        without_contam = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= cov_thresh, 1, 0),
        with_contam = case_when(
          Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
          coverage_percentage >= cov_thresh ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(without_contam != with_contam) %>%
      nrow()
    
    # Add both layers to results
    results <- bind_rows(results,
      # Layer 1: Ignore contamination (hypothetical)
      tibble(
        Coverage_Threshold = cov_thresh,
        Layer = "No",
        Sensitivity = sensitivity1,
        Specificity = specificity1,
        F1_Score = f1_score1,
        Accuracy = accuracy1,
        TP = TP1, FN = FN1, FP = FP1, TN = TN1,
        Sample_Count = nrow(data_layer1),
        Positive_Count = sum(data_layer1$PCR_Result == 1),
        Contaminated_Samples = contaminated_samples,
        Samples_Affected = would_change
      ),
      # Layer 2: With contamination filtering (current approach)
      tibble(
        Coverage_Threshold = cov_thresh,
        Layer = "Yes",
        Sensitivity = sensitivity2,
        Specificity = specificity2,
        F1_Score = f1_score2,
        Accuracy = accuracy2,
        TP = TP2, FN = FN2, FP = FP2, TN = TN2,
        Sample_Count = nrow(data_layer2),
        Positive_Count = sum(data_layer2$PCR_Result == 1),
        Contaminated_Samples = contaminated_samples,
        Samples_Affected = would_change
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Round values
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Sensitivity, Specificity, F1_Score, Accuracy), ~round(., 3)))
  
  # Create heatmaps for sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy only
  metrics_to_plot <- c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Accuracy")
  plots <- list()
  
  for (metric in metrics_to_plot) {
    if (!metric %in% names(results)) {
      message("Warning: ", metric, " column not found in results")
      plots[[metric]] <- ggplot() + 
        labs(title = paste(metric, "-", dataset_name),
             subtitle = "Metric not available")
      next
    }
    
    # Filter out NA values for this metric
    plot_data <- results %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[metric]]))
    
    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
      message("No valid data for metric: ", metric)
      plots[[metric]] <- ggplot() + 
        labs(title = paste(metric),
             subtitle = "No valid data")
      next
    }
    
    # Create the plot
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(Coverage_Threshold), 
                               y = Layer)) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = .data[[metric]]), color = "white", size = 0.5) +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(.data[[metric]], 3)), 
                color = "black", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#626DD0",
        mid = "lightblue",
        high = "red",
        midpoint = 0.8,
        limits = c(0.6, 1.0),
        oob = scales::squish,
        name = metric,
        na.value = "grey90"
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Coverage Threshold (%)",   # x-axis label
        y = "Contamination"                 # y-axis label
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        #panel.grid = element_blank(),
        #plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
      )
    
    plots[[metric]] <- p
  }
  
  # Check if we have valid plots
  valid_plots <- plots[sapply(plots, function(p) inherits(p, "ggplot"))]
  
  if (length(valid_plots) == 3) {
    # Combine the 3 plots horizontally
    combined_plot <- valid_plots[["Sensitivity"]] + valid_plots[["Specificity"]] + valid_plots[["Accuracy"]] +
      plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1, 1))
    
    # Save the plot if requested
    if (save_plot) {
      output_dir <- "contamination_heatmaps"
      if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
        dir.create(output_dir)
      }
      
      filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("contamination_performance_1", dataset_name, ".png"))
      ggsave(filename, plot = combined_plot, width = 15, height = 2.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      
      cat("Plot saved as:", filename, "\n")
    }
    
    return(combined_plot)
    
  } else if (length(valid_plots) > 0) {
    # Create and save what we have
    message("Only ", length(valid_plots), " valid plots created for ", dataset_name)
    
    combined_plot <- wrap_plots(valid_plots, nrow = 1, guides = "collect")
    
    # Save the plot if requested
    if (save_plot) {
      output_dir <- "contamination_heatmaps"
      if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
        dir.create(output_dir)
      }
      
      filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("contamination_performance_", dataset_name, "_partial1.png"))
      ggsave(filename, plot = combined_plot, width = 20, height = 2.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      
      cat("Partial plot saved as:", filename, "\n")
    }
    
    return(combined_plot)
    
  } else {
    message("No valid plots created for ", dataset_name)
    return(ggplot() + 
             labs(title = paste("No valid heatmaps for", dataset_name),
                  subtitle = "Check data structure and contamination column"))
  }
}

reads_file <- "./VCS_Meta_updated.csv"

create_summary_table <- function() {
  summary_list <- list()
  
  # Load the reads data file
  if (file.exists(reads_file)) {
    reads_data <- read_csv(reads_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    if ("fileName" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = fileName)
    }
    if ("totalReads" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(total_reads = totalReads)
    }
    
    if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      possible_id_cols <- c("sample", "Sample", "SampleID", "sampleID", "id", "ID")
      for (col in possible_id_cols) {
        if (col %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
          reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = all_of(col))
          break
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    warning("Reads file not found at: ", reads_file)
    reads_data <- NULL
  }
  
  all_dataset_names <- c("PathCare", "NHLS_GS", "NHLS_TY", "Mucokids", "SUDI", "ALL_COMBINED")
  
  for (ds_name in all_dataset_names) {
    if (!ds_name %in% names(loaded_datasets)) next
    
    ds <- loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]
    
    # 1. Number of samples in sampleset
    num_samples <- length(unique(ds$continuous$sample_id))
    
    # 2. Number of positive PCR detections
    pcr_detections <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      nrow()
    
    # 3. Reads per sample, median (IQR) - from reads file
    read_stats <- "N/A"
    if (!is.null(reads_data) && "sample_id" %in% colnames(reads_data) && 
        "total_reads" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      
      ds_samples <- unique(ds$continuous$sample_id)
      dataset_reads <- reads_data %>%
        filter(sample_id %in% ds_samples) %>%
        pull(total_reads)
      
      if (length(dataset_reads) > 0 && !all(is.na(dataset_reads))) {
        median_reads <- median(dataset_reads, na.rm = TRUE)
        q1_reads <- quantile(dataset_reads, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
        q3_reads <- quantile(dataset_reads, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
        read_stats <- sprintf("%.0f (%.0f-%.0f)", 
                             median_reads, q1_reads, q3_reads)
      }
    }
    
    # 4. Sensitivity at 10% genome coverage (Original)
    sensitivity_10 <- NA
    specificity_10 <- NA
    
    if (!is.null(all_results[[ds_name]]$coverage$results)) {
      cov10_results <- all_results[[ds_name]]$coverage$results %>%
        filter(Threshold == "cov10")
      
      if (nrow(cov10_results) > 0) {
        sensitivity_10 <- cov10_results$Sensitivity[1]
        specificity_10 <- cov10_results$Specificity[1]
      }
    }
    
    # 5. Ct < 30 sensitivity (Original) - FOR ALL DATASETS
ct30_sensitivity_original <- NA
ct30_merged <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0) %>%
  mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0))

TP_ct30 <- sum(ct30_merged$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_merged$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
FN_ct30 <- sum(ct30_merged$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_merged$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ct30_sensitivity_original <- ifelse((TP_ct30 + FN_ct30) > 0, TP_ct30 / (TP_ct30 + FN_ct30), NA_real_)

# 6. Ct < 30 sensitivity (Contamination-Adjusted) - FOR ALL DATASETS
ct30_sensitivity_contam <- NA
ct30_merged_contam <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0) %>%
  mutate(SEQ_Result = case_when(
    Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
    coverage_percentage >= 10 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

TP_ct30_contam <- sum(ct30_merged_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_merged_contam$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
FN_ct30_contam <- sum(ct30_merged_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_merged_contam$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ct30_sensitivity_contam <- ifelse((TP_ct30_contam + FN_ct30_contam) > 0, 
                                  TP_ct30_contam / (TP_ct30_contam + FN_ct30_contam), NA_real_)
    
    # 7. Sequencing success (genome coverage >80%, depth >10)
    sequencing_success <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                                    by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      summarise(
        success = sum(coverage_percentage >= 80 & depth_of_coverage >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = n(),
        percent = ifelse(total > 0, round(success / total * 100, 1), 0)
      )
    
    sequencing_success_str <- if (sequencing_success$total > 0) {
      sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", 
              sequencing_success$success, 
              sequencing_success$total, 
              sequencing_success$percent)
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # 8. Sequencing success for pathogens at Ct values <30
    ct_success <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                            by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & !is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < 30 & ct_values > 0) %>%
      summarise(
        success = sum(coverage_percentage >= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = n(),
        percent = ifelse(total > 0, round(success / total * 100, 1), 0)
      )
    
    ct_success_str <- if (ct_success$total > 0) {
      sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", 
              ct_success$success, 
              ct_success$total, 
              ct_success$percent)
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # Store summary - base metrics for all datasets
    summary_metrics <- c(
      "Number of samples" = as.character(num_samples),
      "Positive PCR detections" = as.character(pcr_detections),
      "Reads per sample, median (IQR)" = read_stats,
      "Sensitivity at 10% genome coverage" = ifelse(!is.na(sensitivity_10), 
                                                    paste0(round(sensitivity_10 * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                                    "N/A"),
      "Specificity at 10% genome coverage" = ifelse(!is.na(specificity_10), 
                                                    paste0(round(specificity_10 * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                                    "N/A"),
      "Sequencing success (coverage >80%, depth >10)" = sequencing_success_str,
      "Sequencing success (Ct <30, coverage >10%)" = ct_success_str,
  # Add Ct < 30 sensitivity metrics for ALL datasets
  "Sensitivity Ct<30 (Original)" = ifelse(!is.na(ct30_sensitivity_original), 
                                          paste0(round(ct30_sensitivity_original * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                          "N/A"),
  "Sensitivity Ct<30 (Contam Adj)" = ifelse(!is.na(ct30_sensitivity_contam), 
                                            paste0(round(ct30_sensitivity_contam * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                            "N/A")
)
    
    summary_list[[ds_name]] <- summary_metrics
  }
  
  # Create summary table
  summary_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, summary_list))
  
  # Add row names as first column
  summary_df <- cbind(
    data.frame(Metric = rownames(summary_df)),
    summary_df
  )
  rownames(summary_df) <- NULL
  
  return(summary_df)
}

# Enhanced function to create Ct < 30 coverage threshold tables with sample-level details
create_ct30_coverage_table <- function(dataset_name) {
  ds <- loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]]
  if (is.null(ds)) {
    cat("Dataset not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get Ct < 30 filtered data
  merged_data <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0)
  
  # Define coverage thresholds
  coverage_thresholds <- c(10, 20, 50, 80, 90)
  
  # Initialize results
  results_list <- list()
  fp_samples_list <- list()
  fn_samples_list <- list()
  
  for (threshold in coverage_thresholds) {
    # ORIGINAL (no contamination adjustment)
    seq_orig <- merged_data %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= threshold, 1, 0))
    
    TP_orig <- sum(seq_orig$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_orig$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN_orig <- sum(seq_orig$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_orig$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP_orig <- sum(seq_orig$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_orig$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN_orig <- sum(seq_orig$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_orig$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    sens_orig <- ifelse((TP_orig + FN_orig) > 0, TP_orig / (TP_orig + FN_orig), NA_real_)
    spec_orig <- ifelse((TN_orig + FP_orig) > 0, TN_orig / (TN_orig + FP_orig), NA_real_)
    
    # CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED
    seq_contam <- merged_data %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = case_when(
        Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
        coverage_percentage >= threshold ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ))
    
    TP_contam <- sum(seq_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_contam$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN_contam <- sum(seq_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_contam$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP_contam <- sum(seq_contam$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_contam$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN_contam <- sum(seq_contam$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_contam$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    sens_contam <- ifelse((TP_contam + FN_contam) > 0, TP_contam / (TP_contam + FN_contam), NA_real_)
    spec_contam <- ifelse((TN_contam + FP_contam) > 0, TN_contam / (TN_contam + FP_contam), NA_real_)
    
    # Store results
    results_list[[as.character(threshold)]] <- tibble(
      Coverage_Threshold = threshold,
      # Original
      TP_Orig = TP_orig,
      FN_Orig = FN_orig,
      FP_Orig = FP_orig,
      TN_Orig = TN_orig,
      Sens_Orig = round(sens_orig * 100, 1),
      Spec_Orig = round(spec_orig * 100, 1),
      # Contam-Adjusted
      TP_Contam = TP_contam,
      FN_Contam = FN_contam,
      FP_Contam = FP_contam,
      TN_Contam = TN_contam,
      Sens_Contam = round(sens_contam * 100, 1),
      Spec_Contam = round(spec_contam * 100, 1)
    )
    
    # Get FP and FN samples for ORIGINAL
    fp_orig_samples <- seq_orig %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result == 1) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, coverage_percentage, ct_values, Contam) %>%
      mutate(Error_Type = "False Positive", Adjustment = "Original")
    
    fn_orig_samples <- seq_orig %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result == 0) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, coverage_percentage, ct_values, Contam) %>%
      mutate(Error_Type = "False Negative", Adjustment = "Original")
    
    # Get FP and FN samples for CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED
    fp_contam_samples <- seq_contam %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result == 1) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, coverage_percentage, ct_values, Contam) %>%
      mutate(Error_Type = "False Positive", Adjustment = "Contam-Adjusted")
    
    fn_contam_samples <- seq_contam %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result == 0) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, coverage_percentage, ct_values, Contam) %>%
      mutate(Error_Type = "False Negative", Adjustment = "Contam-Adjusted")
    
    # Combine and store
    fp_samples_list[[as.character(threshold)]] <- bind_rows(fp_orig_samples, fp_contam_samples) %>%
      mutate(Coverage_Threshold = threshold)
    
    fn_samples_list[[as.character(threshold)]] <- bind_rows(fn_orig_samples, fn_contam_samples) %>%
      mutate(Coverage_Threshold = threshold)
  }
  
  # Combine results
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  # Combine all error samples
  all_fp <- bind_rows(fp_samples_list)
  all_fn <- bind_rows(fn_samples_list)
  all_errors <- bind_rows(all_fp, all_fn) %>%
    arrange(Coverage_Threshold, Error_Type, Adjustment, sample_id)
  
  # Create summary table (Sensitivity/Specificity only)
  summary_table <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      Original = paste0(Sens_Orig, "% / ", Spec_Orig, "%"),
      Contam_Adjusted = paste0(Sens_Contam, "% / ", Spec_Contam, "%"),
      Difference = paste0(round(Sens_Contam - Sens_Orig, 1), "% / ", 
                          round(Spec_Contam - Spec_Orig, 1), "%")
    ) %>%
    select(
      Coverage_Threshold,
      Original,
      Contam_Adjusted,
      Difference
    )
  
  # Create detailed confusion matrix table
  detailed_table <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      Orig_Matrix = paste0("TP=", TP_Orig, ", FN=", FN_Orig, ", FP=", FP_Orig, ", TN=", TN_Orig),
      Contam_Matrix = paste0("TP=", TP_Contam, ", FN=", FN_Contam, ", FP=", FP_Contam, ", TN=", TN_Contam)
    ) %>%
    select(
      Coverage_Threshold,
      Orig_Matrix,
      Contam_Matrix
    )
  
  # Return all tables
  return(list(
    summary = summary_table,
    detailed = detailed_table,
    full_data = results_df,
    errors = all_errors,
    fp_samples = all_fp,
    fn_samples = all_fn
  ))
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Function to calculate Ct < 30 sensitivity for ALL_COMBINED
calculate_ct30_sensitivity <- function() {
  if (!"ALL_COMBINED" %in% names(loaded_datasets)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  ds <- loaded_datasets$ALL_COMBINED
  
  # Merge PCR and continuous data
  merged_data <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, 
                          by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result))  # Remove "Not tested"
  
  # Filter for Ct values < 30
  ct30_data <- merged_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < 30 & ct_values > 0)
  
  # ORIGINAL (no contamination adjustment)
  ct30_original <- ct30_data %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0))
  
  TP_orig <- sum(ct30_original$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_original$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN_orig <- sum(ct30_original$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_original$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  sensitivity_orig <- ifelse((TP_orig + FN_orig) > 0, TP_orig / (TP_orig + FN_orig), NA_real_)
  
  # CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED
  ct30_contam <- ct30_data %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result = case_when(
      Contam == "YES" ~ 0,  # Contaminated samples treated as negative
      coverage_percentage >= 10 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ))
  
  TP_contam <- sum(ct30_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_contam$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN_contam <- sum(ct30_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_contam$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  sensitivity_contam <- ifelse((TP_contam + FN_contam) > 0, 
                               TP_contam / (TP_contam + FN_contam), NA_real_)
  
  # Format results
  result <- tibble(
    Metric = c("Sensitivity at 10% (Ct <30) - Original",
               "Sensitivity at 10% (Ct <30) - Contam Adj"),
    Value = c(
      ifelse(!is.na(sensitivity_orig), paste0(round(sensitivity_orig * 100, 1), "%"), "N/A"),
      ifelse(!is.na(sensitivity_contam), paste0(round(sensitivity_contam * 100, 1), "%"), "N/A")
    )
  )
  
  return(result)
}

# Function to get PCR positive samples count for each dataset
get_pcr_positive_samples <- function() {
  results <- list()
  
  all_dataset_names <- c("PathCare", "NHLS_GS", "NHLS_TY", "Mucokids", "SUDI", "ALL_COMBINED")
  
  for (ds_name in all_dataset_names) {
    if (!ds_name %in% names(loaded_datasets)) next
    
    ds <- loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]
    
    # Count unique samples with at least one PCR positive detection
    pcr_positive_samples <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      distinct(sample_id) %>%
      nrow()
    
    # Total unique samples in dataset
    total_samples <- length(unique(ds$continuous$sample_id))
    
    # Count total PCR positive detections (observations)
    total_detections <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      nrow()
    
    # Get list of positive samples for reference
    positive_sample_list <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      distinct(sample_id) %>%
      pull(sample_id)
    
    results[[ds_name]] <- list(
      dataset = ds_name,
      total_samples = total_samples,
      positive_samples_count = pcr_positive_samples,
      percent_positive = round(pcr_positive_samples / total_samples * 100, 1),
      total_detections = total_detections,
      positive_samples = positive_sample_list
    )
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# Function to create PCR positive counts by pathogen
create_pcr_positive_counts <- function(dataset_name = NULL) {
  
  # If dataset_name is provided, only show that dataset
  # If NULL, show all datasets including combined
  
  if (!is.null(dataset_name) && dataset_name %in% names(loaded_datasets)) {
    datasets_to_process <- list(loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]])
    names(datasets_to_process) <- dataset_name
  } else {
    datasets_to_process <- loaded_datasets
  }
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (ds_name in names(datasets_to_process)) {
    ds <- datasets_to_process[[ds_name]]
    
    # Count PCR positive per pathogen
    pcr_positive <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      group_by(Pathogen) %>%
      summarise(Positive_Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Dataset = ds_name)
    
    # Count total tested per pathogen (non-NA)
    total_tested <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(!is.na(PCR_Result)) %>%
      group_by(Pathogen) %>%
      summarise(Total_Tested = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Dataset = ds_name)
    
    # Combine and calculate percentage
    combined <- pcr_positive %>%
      left_join(total_tested, by = c("Pathogen", "Dataset")) %>%
      mutate(
        Percent_Positive = round(Positive_Count / Total_Tested * 100, 1),
        Percent_Positive_Display = paste0(Percent_Positive, "%")
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Positive_Count))
    
    results_list[[ds_name]] <- combined
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  return(all_results)
}

# Function to display PCR positive counts in a formatted table
display_pcr_positive_counts <- function(dataset_name = NULL, show_combined = TRUE) {
  
  # Get the data
  pcr_data <- create_pcr_positive_counts(dataset_name)
  
  if (is.null(pcr_data) || nrow(pcr_data) == 0) {
    cat("No PCR positive data available\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # If showing all datasets, split by dataset
  if (is.null(dataset_name)) {
    datasets_present <- unique(pcr_data$Dataset)
    
    for (ds in datasets_present) {
      # Skip ALL_COMBINED if not requested
      if (ds == "ALL_COMBINED" && !show_combined) next
      
      cat(paste0("\n### ", ds, "\n\n"))
      
      ds_data <- pcr_data %>% filter(Dataset == ds)
      
      # Check if there are any positives
      if (sum(ds_data$Positive_Count) == 0) {
        cat("*No PCR positive detections in this dataset*\n\n")
        next
      }
      
      # Create the table
      table_data <- ds_data %>%
        select(Pathogen, Positive_Count, Total_Tested, Percent_Positive_Display) %>%
        mutate(
          Pathogen = as.character(Pathogen),
          Positive_Count = as.integer(Positive_Count),
          Total_Tested = as.integer(Total_Tested)
        )
      
      # Add a total row
      total_row <- tibble(
        Pathogen = "**TOTAL**",
        Positive_Count = sum(table_data$Positive_Count),
        Total_Tested = sum(table_data$Total_Tested),
        Percent_Positive_Display = paste0(round(sum(table_data$Positive_Count) / sum(table_data$Total_Tested) * 100, 1), "%")
      )
      
      table_data <- bind_rows(table_data, total_row)
      
      kable(table_data,
            caption = paste("PCR Positive Detections -", ds),
            col.names = c("Pathogen", "Positive", "Tested", "% Positive"),
            escape = FALSE) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
        column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
        row_spec(nrow(table_data) - 1, bold = TRUE, background = "#FFF3CD") %>%
        print()
    }
    
    # If we have ALL_COMBINED and show_combined is TRUE, show it separately
    if (show_combined && "ALL_COMBINED" %in% names(loaded_datasets)) {
      cat("\n### ALL_COMBINED (All Datasets Combined)\n\n")
      
      combined_data <- pcr_data %>% filter(Dataset == "ALL_COMBINED")
      
      if (nrow(combined_data) > 0 && sum(combined_data$Positive_Count) > 0) {
        table_data <- combined_data %>%
          select(Pathogen, Positive_Count, Total_Tested, Percent_Positive_Display) %>%
          mutate(
            Pathogen = as.character(Pathogen),
            Positive_Count = as.integer(Positive_Count),
            Total_Tested = as.integer(Total_Tested)
          )
        
        total_row <- tibble(
          Pathogen = "**TOTAL**",
          Positive_Count = sum(table_data$Positive_Count),
          Total_Tested = sum(table_data$Total_Tested),
          Percent_Positive_Display = paste0(round(sum(table_data$Positive_Count) / sum(table_data$Total_Tested) * 100, 1), "%")
        )
        
        table_data <- bind_rows(table_data, total_row)
        
        kable(table_data,
              caption = "PCR Positive Detections - ALL COMBINED",
              col.names = c("Pathogen", "Positive", "Tested", "% Positive"),
              escape = FALSE) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
          column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
          row_spec(nrow(table_data) - 1, bold = TRUE, background = "#FFF3CD") %>%
          print()
      } else {
        cat("*No PCR positive detections in combined dataset*\n\n")
      }
    }
    
  } else {
    # Single dataset
    ds_data <- pcr_data
    
    if (sum(ds_data$Positive_Count) == 0) {
      cat("*No PCR positive detections in this dataset*\n\n")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    
    table_data <- ds_data %>%
      select(Pathogen, Positive_Count, Total_Tested, Percent_Positive_Display) %>%
      mutate(
        Pathogen = as.character(Pathogen),
        Positive_Count = as.integer(Positive_Count),
        Total_Tested = as.integer(Total_Tested)
      )
    
    total_row <- tibble(
      Pathogen = "**TOTAL**",
      Positive_Count = sum(table_data$Positive_Count),
      Total_Tested = sum(table_data$Total_Tested),
      Percent_Positive_Display = paste0(round(sum(table_data$Positive_Count) / sum(table_data$Total_Tested) * 100, 1), "%")
    )
    
    table_data <- bind_rows(table_data, total_row)
    
    kable(table_data,
          caption = paste("PCR Positive Detections -", dataset_name),
          col.names = c("Pathogen", "Positive", "Tested", "% Positive"),
          escape = FALSE) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
      row_spec(nrow(table_data) - 1, bold = TRUE, background = "#FFF3CD") %>%
      print()
  }
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
    Pathogens = length(tested_pathogens),

    True_Total_Obs = detected_count + not_detected_count,
    PCR_Positive = detected_count,
    PCR_Negative = not_detected_count,
    Not_Tested = sum(is.na(ds$pcr$PCR_Result), na.rm = TRUE),
    Pathogens_Tested = paste(tested_pathogens, collapse = "<br>")
  )
})
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
calculate_basic_stats <- function(dataset_name, dataset) {
  
  num_samples <- length(unique(dataset$continuous$sample_id))
  
  # Count only pathogens actually tested (exclude Not Tested)
  tested_pathogens <- dataset$pcr %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result)) %>%
    distinct(Pathogen) %>%
    pull(Pathogen)
  num_pathogens <- length(tested_pathogens)
  
  total_obs <- nrow(dataset$pcr)
  pcr_detected <- sum(dataset$pcr$PCR_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  pcr_not_detected <- sum(dataset$pcr$PCR_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  basic_stats <- tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Number of unique samples", "Number of pathogens", "Total observations",
      "PCR detections", "PCR non-detections"
    ),
    Value = c(
      num_samples, num_pathogens, total_obs, pcr_detected, pcr_not_detected
    )
  )
  
  kable(basic_stats, caption = paste("Basic Statistics for", dataset_name)) %>% 
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```

### ROC curves

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

create_roc_plots <- function(dataset_name, save_plot = FALSE) {
  ds <- loaded_datasets[[dataset_name]]
  roc_data <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result))
  
  if (nrow(roc_data) == 0 || length(unique(roc_data$PCR_Result)) != 2) {
    cat("Not enough data for ROC analysis\n")
    return()
  }
  
  roc_coverage <- roc(PCR_Result ~ coverage_percentage, data = roc_data)
  roc_rpm <- roc(PCR_Result ~ rpm, data = roc_data)
  roc_depth <- roc(PCR_Result ~ depth_of_coverage, data = roc_data)
  
  performance_summary <- tibble(
    Metric = c("Genome coverage", "RPM", "Depth"),
    AUC = c(auc(roc_coverage), auc(roc_rpm), auc(roc_depth))
  )
  
  kable(performance_summary, caption = "ROC Performance Metrics") %>% 
    kable_styling() %>% 
    print()
  
  # Put Genome coverage LAST → it will be drawn on TOP
  roc_list <- list(
    RPM = roc_rpm,
    Depth = roc_depth,
    `Genome coverage` = roc_coverage
  )
  
  legend_order <- c("Depth", "Genome coverage", "RPM")
  
  p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    labs(
      title = NULL,  
      subtitle = paste(
        "Depth AUC =", round(auc(roc_depth), 3),
        "| Genome coverage AUC =", round(auc(roc_coverage), 3), 
        "| RPM AUC =", round(auc(roc_rpm), 3)
      ),
      x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
      y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Metric",
      values = c(
        "Depth" = "#B831E3",
        "Genome coverage" = "#E38031", 
        "RPM" =  "#31E3B7"
      ),
      breaks = legend_order,  
      labels = legend_order   
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.25)
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  if (save_plot) {
    if (!dir.exists("figures")) dir.create("figures")
    outfile <- paste0("figures/ROC_", dataset_name, ".png")
    
    # Save with explicit sizes
    ggsave(
      filename = outfile,
      plot = p,
      width = 10,      # inches
      height = 7,      # inches
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"     # Ensure white background
    )
    
    cat("Plot saved to:", outfile, "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}


if ("PathCare" %in% names(loaded_datasets)) {
  create_roc_plots("PathCare", save_plot = TRUE)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Function to analyze coverage thresholds with Ct filtering
analyze_coverage_ct_filter <- function(dataset, ct_threshold = 30) {
  if (!all(c("pcr", "continuous") %in% names(dataset))) {
    return(list(results = NULL, fn_samples = list(), fp_samples = list()))
  }
  
  coverage_thresholds <- c(10, 20, 50, 80, 90)
  results <- list()
  fn_samples <- list()
  fp_samples <- list()
  
  merged_data <- inner_join(dataset$pcr, dataset$continuous, 
                          by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen"))
  
  # Filter data to include only samples with Ct values < threshold
  filtered_data <- merged_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < ct_threshold & ct_values > 0)
  
  for (threshold in coverage_thresholds) {
    threshold_label <- paste0("cov", threshold)
    
    seq_data <- filtered_data %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= threshold, 1, 0))
    
    # Confusion matrix calculations
    TP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
    specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
    
    results[[threshold_label]] <- tibble(
      Threshold = threshold_label,
      Ct_Filter = paste0("Ct <", ct_threshold),
      TP = TP, FN = FN, FP = FP, TN = TN,
      Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
      Specificity = round(specificity, 3)
    )
    
    fn_samples[[threshold_label]] <- seq_data %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result == 0) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, coverage_percentage, depth_of_coverage, ct_values)
    
    fp_samples[[threshold_label]] <- seq_data %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result == 1) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, coverage_percentage, depth_of_coverage, ct_values)
  }
  
  list(
    results = bind_rows(results),
    fn_samples = fn_samples,
    fp_samples = fp_samples
  )
}

# Function to analyze RPM thresholds with Ct filtering
analyze_rpm_ct_filter <- function(dataset, ct_threshold = 30) {
  if (!all(c("pcr", "continuous") %in% names(dataset))) {
    return(list(results = NULL, fn_samples = list(), fp_samples = list()))
  }
  
  rpm_thresholds <- c(10, 100, 500, 1000)
  results <- list()
  fn_samples <- list()
  fp_samples <- list()
  
  merged_data <- inner_join(dataset$pcr, dataset$continuous, 
                          by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen"))
  
  # Filter data to include only samples with Ct values > threshold
  filtered_data <- merged_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < ct_threshold & ct_values > 0)
  
  for (threshold in rpm_thresholds) {
    threshold_label <- paste0("rpm", threshold)
    
    seq_data <- filtered_data %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(rpm >= threshold, 1, 0))
    
    # Confusion matrix calculations
    TP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
    specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
    
    results[[threshold_label]] <- tibble(
      Threshold = threshold_label,
      Ct_Filter = paste0("Ct <", ct_threshold),
      TP = TP, FN = FN, FP = FP, TN = TN,
      Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
      Specificity = round(specificity, 3)
    )
    
    fn_samples[[threshold_label]] <- seq_data %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & SEQ_Result == 0) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values)
    
    fp_samples[[threshold_label]] <- seq_data %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 0 & SEQ_Result == 1) %>%
      select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values)
  }
  
  list(
    results = bind_rows(results),
    fn_samples = fn_samples,
    fp_samples = fp_samples
  )
}

ct_filter_results <- map(loaded_datasets, function(ds) {
  tryCatch({
    list(
      coverage = analyze_coverage_ct_filter(ds, ct_threshold = 30),
      rpm = analyze_rpm_ct_filter(ds, ct_threshold = 30)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Ct filter analysis failed for dataset: ", e$message)
    list(coverage = NULL, rpm = NULL)
  })
})
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
List_of_sample_in_red <- c("C069864")

create_fn_fp <- function(dataset_name) {
  ds_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]
  
  process_samples <- function(sample_list, type, metric) {
    if (is.null(sample_list) || length(sample_list) == 0) {
      cat(paste0("\n#### No ", type, " Samples found for ", metric, " metric\n"))
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    
    all_samples <- tibble()
    already_seen <- tibble(sample_id = character(), Pathogen = character())

    for (thresh in names(sample_list)) {
      current <- sample_list[[thresh]]
      if (is.null(current) || nrow(current) == 0) next
      
      # Filter: remove NA ct_values and only keep ct_values < 30
      current <- current %>% 
        filter(!is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < 30 & ct_values > 0) %>% 
        mutate(Threshold = thresh)
      
      # Skip if no rows remain after filtering
      if (nrow(current) == 0) next
      
      new_samples <- anti_join(current, already_seen, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen"))
      already_seen <- bind_rows(already_seen, new_samples %>% select(sample_id, Pathogen))
      
      if (nrow(new_samples) > 0) {
        enriched <- new_samples %>%
          mutate(Metric = metric)
        
        all_samples <- bind_rows(all_samples, enriched)
      }
    }

    if (nrow(all_samples) > 0) {
      cat(paste0("\n#### ", type, " Samples (", metric, ")\n"))
      
      # Define column order
      preferred_order <- c("sample_id", "Pathogen", "PCR_Result", "SEQ_Result", "Threshold", 
                          "coverage_percentage", "rpm", "depth_of_coverage", "ct_values")
      
      # Create the table
      table_data <- all_samples %>% 
        select(any_of(preferred_order)) %>% 
        arrange(Threshold, Pathogen, sample_id)
      
      # Create kable object
      kable_obj <- kable(table_data,
                        caption = paste(type, "samples for", dataset_name, "(", metric, ")")) %>% 
        kable_styling()
      
      # Apply red color to sample IDs that are in the predefined list
      if (length(List_of_sample_in_red) > 0) {
        error_rows <- which(table_data$sample_id %in% List_of_sample_in_red)
        if (length(error_rows) > 0) {
          kable_obj <- kable_obj %>%
            row_spec(error_rows, color = "red", bold = TRUE)
        }
      }
      
      print(kable_obj)
      
    } else {
      cat(paste0("\n#### No ", type, " Samples found for ", metric, " metric\n"))
    }
  }
  
  # Process metrics
  if (!is.null(ds_results$coverage)) {
    process_samples(ds_results$coverage$fn_samples, "False Negatives", "coverage")
    process_samples(ds_results$coverage$fp_samples, "False Positives", "coverage")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(ds_results$rpm)) {
    process_samples(ds_results$rpm$fn_samples, "False Negatives", "rpm")
    process_samples(ds_results$rpm$fp_samples, "False Positives", "rpm")
  }
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
calculate_basic_stats <- function(dataset_name, dataset) {
  num_samples <- length(unique(dataset$continuous$sample_id))
  
  # Count only pathogens actually tested (exclude Not Tested)
  tested_pathogens <- dataset$pcr %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result)) %>%
    distinct(Pathogen) %>%
    pull(Pathogen)
  num_pathogens <- length(tested_pathogens)
  
  total_obs <- nrow(dataset$pcr)
  pcr_detected <- sum(dataset$pcr$PCR_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  pcr_not_detected <- sum(dataset$pcr$PCR_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  basic_stats <- tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Number of unique samples", "Number of pathogens", "Total observations",
      "PCR detections", "PCR non-detections"
    ),
    Value = c(
      num_samples, num_pathogens, total_obs, pcr_detected, pcr_not_detected
    )
  )
  
  kable(basic_stats, caption = paste("Basic Statistics for", dataset_name)) %>% 
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}


if ("NHLS_GS" %in% names(loaded_datasets)) {
  calculate_basic_stats("NHLS_GS", loaded_datasets$NHLS_GS)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
create_summary_tables <- function(dataset_name) {
  ALL_cols <- c("Threshold", "TP", "FN", "FP", "TN", "Sensitivity", "Specificity")
  
  if (!is.null(all_results[[dataset_name]]$coverage$results)) {
    cat("#### Coverage Threshold Performance\n")
    kable(all_results[[dataset_name]]$coverage$results %>% select(all_of(ALL_cols)),
          caption = "Coverage Threshold Performance") %>% 
      kable_styling() %>% 
      print()
  }
  
  if (!is.null(all_results[[dataset_name]]$rpm$results)) {
    cat("\n#### RPM Threshold Performance\n")
    kable(all_results[[dataset_name]]$rpm$results %>% select(all_of(ALL_cols)),
          caption = "RPM Threshold Performance") %>% 
      kable_styling() %>% 
      print()
  }
  
  if (!is.null(all_results[[dataset_name]]$depth$results)) {
    cat("\n#### Depth Threshold Performance\n")
    kable(all_results[[dataset_name]]$depth$results %>% select(all_of(ALL_cols)),
          caption = "Depth Threshold Performance") %>% 
      kable_styling() %>% 
      print()
  }
}
```

## Error Analysis {.tabset .tabset-fade}


```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

List_of_sample_in_red <- c("C069864", "K063382-R1", "K063425-R1", "K063434-R1", "ST06933714H", "C067581_S32", "C067580_S31", "C067583_S34", "C070253", "C070878", "C070343", "C070877", "C070887")

create_fn_fp_tables <- function(dataset_name) {
  ds_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]
  
  process_samples <- function(sample_list, type, metric) {
    if (is.null(sample_list) || length(sample_list) == 0) {
      cat(paste0("\n#### No ", type, " Samples found for ", metric, " metric\n"))
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    
    all_samples <- tibble()
    already_seen <- tibble(sample_id = character(), Pathogen = character())

    for (thresh in names(sample_list)) {
      current <- sample_list[[thresh]]
      if (is.null(current) || nrow(current) == 0) next
      
      current <- current %>% mutate(Threshold = thresh)
      new_samples <- anti_join(current, already_seen, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen"))
      already_seen <- bind_rows(already_seen, new_samples %>% select(sample_id, Pathogen))
      
      if (nrow(new_samples) > 0) {
        enriched <- new_samples %>%
          mutate(Metric = metric)
        
        all_samples <- bind_rows(all_samples, enriched)
      }
    }

    if (nrow(all_samples) > 0) {
      cat(paste0("\n#### ", type, " Samples (", metric, ")\n"))
      
      # Define column order
      preferred_order <- c("sample_id", "Pathogen", "PCR_Result", "SEQ_Result", "Threshold", 
                          "coverage_percentage", "rpm", "depth_of_coverage", "ct_values")
      
      # Create the table
      table_data <- all_samples %>% 
        select(any_of(preferred_order)) %>% 
        arrange(Threshold, Pathogen, sample_id)
      
      # Create kable object
      kable_obj <- kable(table_data,
                        caption = paste(type, "samples for", dataset_name, "(", metric, ")")) %>% 
        kable_styling()
      
      # Apply red color to sample IDs that are in the predefined list
      if (length(List_of_sample_in_red) > 0) {
        error_rows <- which(table_data$sample_id %in% List_of_sample_in_red)
        if (length(error_rows) > 0) {
          kable_obj <- kable_obj %>%
            row_spec(error_rows, color = "red", bold = TRUE)
        }
      }
      
      print(kable_obj)
      
    } else {
      cat(paste0("\n#### No ", type, " Samples found for ", metric, " metric\n"))
    }
  }
  
  # Process metrics
  if (!is.null(ds_results$coverage)) {
    process_samples(ds_results$coverage$fn_samples, "False Negatives", "coverage")
    process_samples(ds_results$coverage$fp_samples, "False Positives", "coverage")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(ds_results$rpm)) {
    process_samples(ds_results$rpm$fn_samples, "False Negatives", "rpm")
    process_samples(ds_results$rpm$fp_samples, "False Positives", "rpm")
  }
}


```
