## Comprehensive Contamination-Adjusted Error Analysis

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=17}
# Function to create contamination-adjusted FP/FN tables - SHOWING ONLY CONTAM-ADJUSTED ERRORS
create_contam_adjusted_fn_fp_tables <- function(dataset_name) {
  ds_results <- all_results[[dataset_name]]
  
  if (is.null(ds_results)) {
    cat("No results found for dataset:", dataset_name, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Process coverage
  if (!is.null(ds_results$coverage)) {
    cat("\n#### Coverage Thresholds\n\n")
    
    # Get thresholds from coverage results
    thresholds <- c("cov10", "cov20", "cov50", "cov80", "cov90")
    threshold_values <- c(10, 20, 50, 80, 90)
    
    for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
      thresh <- thresholds[i]
      thresh_val <- threshold_values[i]
      
      fp_samples <- ds_results$coverage$fp_samples[[thresh]]
      fn_samples <- ds_results$coverage$fn_samples[[thresh]]
      
      # Get contamination-adjusted FP (only those NOT contaminated)
      if (!is.null(fp_samples) && nrow(fp_samples) > 0) {
        fp_adj <- fp_samples %>%
          filter(Contam != "YES") %>%
          select(-Contam)  # Remove Contam column since all are "NO"
        
        if (nrow(fp_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, "% - False Positives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fp_adj), " samples\n\n"))
          
          fp_display <- fp_adj %>%
            select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%
            arrange(Pathogen, sample_id)
          
          kable(fp_display,
                caption = paste("False Positives - Contam Adj (", dataset_name, ", ", thresh_val, "%)", sep = "")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            print()
        }
      }
      
      # Get contamination-adjusted FN (only those NOT contaminated)
      if (!is.null(fn_samples) && nrow(fn_samples) > 0) {
        fn_adj <- fn_samples %>%
          filter(Contam != "YES") %>%
          select(-Contam)  # Remove Contam column since all are "NO"
        
        if (nrow(fn_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, "% - False Negatives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fn_adj), " samples\n\n"))
          
          fn_display <- fn_adj %>%
            select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%
            arrange(Pathogen, sample_id)
          
          kable(fn_display,
                caption = paste("False Negatives - Contam Adj (", dataset_name, ", ", thresh_val, "%)", sep = "")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            print()
        }
      }
      
      cat("\n---\n\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Process RPM
  if (!is.null(ds_results$rpm)) {
    cat("\n#### RPM Thresholds\n\n")
    
    thresholds <- c("rpm1", "rpm10", "rpm100", "rpm1000")
    threshold_values <- c(1, 10, 100, 1000)
    
    for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
      thresh <- thresholds[i]
      thresh_val <- threshold_values[i]
      
      fp_samples <- ds_results$rpm$fp_samples[[thresh]]
      fn_samples <- ds_results$rpm$fn_samples[[thresh]]
      
      # Get contamination-adjusted FP (only those NOT contaminated)
      if (!is.null(fp_samples) && nrow(fp_samples) > 0) {
        fp_adj <- fp_samples %>%
          filter(Contam != "YES") %>%
          select(-Contam)
        
        if (nrow(fp_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, " RPM - False Positives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fp_adj), " samples\n\n"))
          
          fp_display <- fp_adj %>%
            select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%
            arrange(Pathogen, sample_id)
          
          kable(fp_display,
                caption = paste("False Positives - Contam Adj (", dataset_name, ", ", thresh_val, " RPM)", sep = "")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            print()
        }
      }
      
      # Get contamination-adjusted FN (only those NOT contaminated)
      if (!is.null(fn_samples) && nrow(fn_samples) > 0) {
        fn_adj <- fn_samples %>%
          filter(Contam != "YES") %>%
          select(-Contam)
        
        if (nrow(fn_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, " RPM - False Negatives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fn_adj), " samples\n\n"))
          
          fn_display <- fn_adj %>%
            select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%
            arrange(Pathogen, sample_id)
          
          kable(fn_display,
                caption = paste("False Negatives - Contam Adj (", dataset_name, ", ", thresh_val, " RPM)", sep = "")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            print()
        }
      }
      
      cat("\n---\n\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Process Depth
  if (!is.null(ds_results$depth)) {
    cat("\n#### Depth Thresholds\n\n")
    
    thresholds <- c("depth10", "depth30")
    threshold_values <- c(10, 30)
    
    for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
      thresh <- thresholds[i]
      thresh_val <- threshold_values[i]
      
      fp_samples <- ds_results$depth$fp_samples[[thresh]]
      fn_samples <- ds_results$depth$fn_samples[[thresh]]
      
      # Get contamination-adjusted FP (only those NOT contaminated)
      if (!is.null(fp_samples) && nrow(fp_samples) > 0) {
        fp_adj <- fp_samples %>%
          filter(Contam != "YES") %>%
          select(-Contam)
        
        if (nrow(fp_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, " Depth - False Positives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fp_adj), " samples\n\n"))
          
          fp_display <- fp_adj %>%
            select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%
            arrange(Pathogen, sample_id)
          
          kable(fp_display,
                caption = paste("False Positives - Contam Adj (", dataset_name, ", ", thresh_val, " Depth)", sep = "")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            print()
        }
      }
      
      # Get contamination-adjusted FN (only those NOT contaminated)
      if (!is.null(fn_samples) && nrow(fn_samples) > 0) {
        fn_adj <- fn_samples %>%
          filter(Contam != "YES") %>%
          select(-Contam)
        
        if (nrow(fn_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, " Depth - False Negatives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fn_adj), " samples\n\n"))
          
          fn_display <- fn_adj %>%
            select(sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%
            arrange(Pathogen, sample_id)
          
          kable(fn_display,
                caption = paste("False Negatives - Contam Adj (", dataset_name, ", ", thresh_val, " Depth)", sep = "")) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            print()
        }
      }
      
      cat("\n---\n\n")
    }
  }
}

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Process coverage
  if (!is.null(ds_results$coverage)) {
    cat("\n#### Coverage Thresholds\n\n")
    
    thresholds <- c("cov10", "cov20", "cov50", "cov80", "cov90")
    threshold_values <- c(10, 20, 50, 80, 90)
    
    for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
      thresh <- thresholds[i]
      thresh_val <- threshold_values[i]
      
      fp_samples <- ds_results$coverage$fp_samples[[thresh]]

      if (!is.null(fp_samples) && nrow(fp_samples) > 0) {

          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, "% - False Positives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fp_adj), " samples\n\n"))

        }
      }

          select(-Contam)
        
        if (nrow(fn_adj) > 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n**Threshold = ", thresh_val, "% - False Negatives (Contamination-Adjusted):** ", nrow(fn_adj), " samples\n\n"))

          fn_display <- fn_adj %>%
            left_join(ds$pcr %>% select(sample_id, Pathogen, original_dataset), 
                      by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
            select(original_dataset, sample_id, Pathogen, PCR_Result, SEQ_Result, 
                   coverage_percentage, rpm, depth_of_coverage, ct_values) %>%

  }
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Enhanced summary table function that accounts for Contam = YES
create_contamination_adjusted_summary_table <- function() {
  summary_list <- list()
  
  # Load the reads data file (same as original)
  if (file.exists(reads_file)) {
    reads_data <- read_csv(reads_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Standardize column names
    if ("fileName" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = fileName)
    }
    if ("totalReads" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(total_reads = totalReads)
    }
    
    if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      possible_id_cols <- c("sample", "Sample", "SampleID", "sampleID", "id", "ID")
      for (col in possible_id_cols) {
        if (col %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
          reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = all_of(col))
          break
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    warning("Reads file not found at: ", reads_file)
    reads_data <- NULL
  }
  
  # Update dataset names to include combined ones
  all_dataset_names <- c("PathCare", "NHLS_GS", "NHLS_TY", "Mucokids", "SUDI", "ALL_COMBINED")
  
  for (ds_name in all_dataset_names) {
    if (!ds_name %in% names(loaded_datasets)) next
    
    ds <- loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]
    
    # 1. Number of samples in sampleset
    num_samples <- length(unique(ds$continuous$sample_id))
    
    # 2. Number of positive PCR detections
    pcr_detections <- ds$pcr %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      nrow()
    
    # 3. Number of contaminated samples/observations
    # Count unique samples with contamination
    contaminated_samples <- ds$continuous %>%
      filter(Contam == "YES") %>%
      distinct(sample_id) %>%
      nrow()
    
    contaminated_observations <- ds$continuous %>%
      filter(Contam == "YES") %>%
      nrow()
    
    # 4. Reads per sample, median (IQR) - from reads file
    read_stats <- "N/A"
    if (!is.null(reads_data) && "sample_id" %in% colnames(reads_data) && 
        "total_reads" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      
      ds_samples <- unique(ds$continuous$sample_id)
      dataset_reads <- reads_data %>%
        filter(sample_id %in% ds_samples) %>%
        pull(total_reads)
      
      if (length(dataset_reads) > 0 && !all(is.na(dataset_reads))) {
        median_reads <- median(dataset_reads, na.rm = TRUE)
        q1_reads <- quantile(dataset_reads, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
        q3_reads <- quantile(dataset_reads, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
        read_stats <- sprintf("%.0f (%.0f-%.0f)", 
                             median_reads, q1_reads, q3_reads)
      }
    }
    
    # 5. Sensitivity at 10% genome coverage (ORIGINAL - without contamination adjustment)
    sensitivity_10_original <- NA
    specificity_10_original <- NA
    
    if (!is.null(all_results[[ds_name]]$coverage$results)) {
      cov10_results <- all_results[[ds_name]]$coverage$results %>%
        filter(Threshold == "cov10")
      
      if (nrow(cov10_results) > 0) {
        sensitivity_10_original <- cov10_results$Sensitivity[1]
        specificity_10_original <- cov10_results$Specificity[1]
      }
    }
    
    # 6. Sensitivity at 10% genome coverage (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
    sensitivity_10_contam <- NA
    specificity_10_contam <- NA
    
    if (!is.null(all_results[[ds_name]]$coverage$results_contam)) {
      cov10_results_contam <- all_results[[ds_name]]$coverage$results_contam %>%
        filter(Threshold == "cov10")
      
      if (nrow(cov10_results_contam) > 0) {
        sensitivity_10_contam <- cov10_results_contam$Sensitivity[1]
        specificity_10_contam <- cov10_results_contam$Specificity[1]
      }
    }
    
    # 7. Sequencing success (genome coverage >80%, depth >10) - ORIGINAL
    sequencing_success_original <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                                    by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1) %>%
      summarise(
        success = sum(coverage_percentage >= 80 & depth_of_coverage >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = n(),
        percent = ifelse(total > 0, round(success / total * 100, 1), 0)
      )
    
    sequencing_success_original_str <- if (sequencing_success_original$total > 0) {
      sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", 
              sequencing_success_original$success, 
              sequencing_success_original$total, 
              sequencing_success_original$percent)
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # 8. Sequencing success (genome coverage >80%, depth >10) - CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED
    # Exclude contaminated samples
    sequencing_success_contam <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                                    by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & Contam == "NO") %>%
      summarise(
        success = sum(coverage_percentage >= 80 & depth_of_coverage >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = n(),
        percent = ifelse(total > 0, round(success / total * 100, 1), 0)
      )
    
    sequencing_success_contam_str <- if (sequencing_success_contam$total > 0) {
      sprintf("%d/%d (%.3f%%)", 
              sequencing_success_contam$success, 
              sequencing_success_contam$total, 
              sequencing_success_contam$percent)
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # 9. Sequencing success for pathogens at Ct values <30 - ORIGINAL
    ct_success_original <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                            by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & !is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < 30 & ct_values > 0) %>%
      summarise(
        success = sum(coverage_percentage >= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = n(),
        percent = ifelse(total > 0, round(success / total * 100, 1), 0)
      )
    
    ct_success_original_str <- if (ct_success_original$total > 0) {
      sprintf("%d/%d (%.3f%%)", 
              ct_success_original$success, 
              ct_success_original$total, 
              ct_success_original$percent)
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # 10. Sequencing success for pathogens at Ct values <30 - CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED
    ct_success_contam <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous,
                            by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
      filter(PCR_Result == 1 & Contam == "NO" & !is.na(ct_values) & ct_values < 30 & ct_values > 0) %>%
      summarise(
        success = sum(coverage_percentage >= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = n(),
        percent = ifelse(total > 0, round(success / total * 100, 1), 0)
      )
    
    ct_success_contam_str <- if (ct_success_contam$total > 0) {
      sprintf("%d/%d (%.3f%%)", 
              ct_success_contam$success, 
              ct_success_contam$total, 
              ct_success_contam$percent)
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # 11. Ct < 30 Sensitivity at 10% coverage (ORIGINAL) - FOR ALL DATASETS
ct30_sensitivity_original <- NA
ct30_data_orig <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0) %>%
  mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0))

TP_ct30_orig <- sum(ct30_data_orig$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_data_orig$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
FN_ct30_orig <- sum(ct30_data_orig$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_data_orig$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ct30_sensitivity_original <- ifelse((TP_ct30_orig + FN_ct30_orig) > 0, 
                                    TP_ct30_orig / (TP_ct30_orig + FN_ct30_orig), NA_real_)

# 12. Ct < 30 Sensitivity at 10% coverage (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED) - FOR ALL DATASETS
ct30_sensitivity_contam <- NA
ct30_data_contam <- inner_join(ds$pcr, ds$continuous, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0) %>%
  mutate(SEQ_Result = case_when(
    Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
    coverage_percentage >= 10 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

TP_ct30_contam <- sum(ct30_data_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_data_contam$SEQ_Result == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
FN_ct30_contam <- sum(ct30_data_contam$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_data_contam$SEQ_Result == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ct30_sensitivity_contam <- ifelse((TP_ct30_contam + FN_ct30_contam) > 0, 
                                  TP_ct30_contam / (TP_ct30_contam + FN_ct30_contam), NA_real_)

    
    # Store summary with all requested metrics (including contamination stats)
    summary_list[[ds_name]] <- c(
      "Number of samples" = as.character(num_samples),
      "Positive PCR detections" = as.character(pcr_detections),
      "Contaminated samples" = as.character(contaminated_samples),
      "Contaminated observations" = as.character(contaminated_observations),
      "Reads per sample, median (IQR)" = read_stats,
      "Sensitivity at 10% (Original)" = ifelse(!is.na(sensitivity_10_original), 
                                                    paste0(round(sensitivity_10_original * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                                    "N/A"),
      "Specificity at 10% (Original)" = ifelse(!is.na(specificity_10_original), 
                                                    paste0(round(specificity_10_original * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                                    "N/A"),
      "Sensitivity at 10% (Contam Adj)" = ifelse(!is.na(sensitivity_10_contam), 
                                                    paste0(round(sensitivity_10_contam * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                                    "N/A"),
      "Specificity at 10% (Contam Adj)" = ifelse(!is.na(specificity_10_contam), 
                                                    paste0(round(specificity_10_contam * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                                    "N/A"),
      "Sequencing success (Original)" = sequencing_success_original_str,
      "Sequencing success (Contam Adj)" = sequencing_success_contam_str,
      "Ct <30 success (Original)" = ct_success_original_str,
      "Ct <30 success (Contam Adj)" = ct_success_contam_str,
      # Add these to the summary_list[[ds_name]] assignment
"Ct <30 Sensitivity (Original)" = ifelse(!is.na(ct30_sensitivity_original), 
                                         paste0(round(ct30_sensitivity_original * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                         "N/A"),
"Ct <30 Sensitivity (Contam Adj)" = ifelse(!is.na(ct30_sensitivity_contam), 
                                           paste0(round(ct30_sensitivity_contam * 100, 1), "%"), 
                                           "N/A")
    )
  }
  
  # Create summary data frame
  summary_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, summary_list))
  
  # Add row names as first column
  summary_df <- cbind(
    data.frame(Metric = rownames(summary_df)),
    summary_df
  )
  rownames(summary_df) <- NULL
  
  return(summary_df)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

# Load strategy data
strategy_file <- "./Strat_data.xlsx"
strategy_data <- read_excel(strategy_file)

# Function to calculate Clopper-Pearson 95% CI
calc_clopper_pearson_ci <- function(x, n, conf_level = 0.95) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(NA, NA))
  if (x == 0) {
    lower <- 0
    upper <- 1 - (1 - conf_level)^(1/n)
  } else if (x == n) {
    lower <- (1 - conf_level)^(1/n)
    upper <- 1
  } else {
    alpha <- 1 - conf_level
    lower <- qbeta(alpha/2, x, n - x + 1)
    upper <- qbeta(1 - alpha/2, x + 1, n - x)
  }
  return(c(lower, upper))
}

# Function to calculate strategy-based metrics (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
calculate_strategy_metrics_contam_adj <- function() {
  
  # Load strategy data
  strategy_file <- "./Strat_data.xlsx"
  strategy_data <- read_excel(strategy_file)
  
  # Get unique strategies
  strategies <- unique(strategy_data$Strategy)
  strategies <- strategies[order(strategies)]  # Sort
  
  # Initialize results list
  results <- list()
  
  for (strat in strategies) {
    # Get samples for this strategy
    strat_samples <- strategy_data %>%
      filter(Strategy == strat) %>%
      pull(sample_id)
    
    # Combine all datasets to get full data
    all_pcr <- bind_rows(lapply(names(loaded_datasets), function(ds_name) {
      if (ds_name != "ALL_COMBINED") {
        loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]$pcr %>% mutate(Dataset = ds_name)
      }
    }))
    
    all_continuous <- bind_rows(lapply(names(loaded_datasets), function(ds_name) {
      if (ds_name != "ALL_COMBINED") {
        loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]$continuous %>% mutate(Dataset = ds_name)
      }
    }))
    
    # Filter to strategy samples
    pcr_strat <- all_pcr %>% filter(sample_id %in% strat_samples)
    cont_strat <- all_continuous %>% filter(sample_id %in% strat_samples)
    
    # Merge data
    merged_data <- inner_join(pcr_strat, cont_strat, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen", "Dataset"))
    
    # 1. Median sequencing depth (reads per sample)
    reads_stats <- "N/A"
    if (file.exists(reads_file)) {
      reads_data <- read_csv(reads_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
      
      if ("fileName" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
        reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = fileName)
      }
      if ("totalReads" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
        reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(total_reads = totalReads)
      }
      
      if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
        possible_id_cols <- c("sample", "Sample", "SampleID", "sampleID", "id", "ID")
        for (col in possible_id_cols) {
          if (col %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
            reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = all_of(col))
            break
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Filter to strategy samples
      strat_reads <- reads_data %>%
        filter(sample_id %in% strat_samples) %>%
        pull(total_reads)
      
      if (length(strat_reads) > 0 && !all(is.na(strat_reads))) {
        median_reads <- median(strat_reads, na.rm = TRUE)
        q1_reads <- quantile(strat_reads, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
        q3_reads <- quantile(strat_reads, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
        reads_stats <- sprintf("%.0f (%.0f - %.0f)", 
                               median_reads, q1_reads, q3_reads)
      }
    }
    
    # 2. Specificity at 10% coverage (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
    seq_data <- merged_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(PCR_Result)) %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0)) %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result_Adj = case_when(
        Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ SEQ_Result
      ))
    
    # Use contamination-adjusted SEQ_Result
    TP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(seq_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP) > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
    sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
    
    # Calculate 95% CI using Clopper-Pearson
    spec_ci <- calc_clopper_pearson_ci(TN, TN + FP)
    sens_ci <- calc_clopper_pearson_ci(TP, TP + FN)
    
    specificity_str <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                               specificity * 100, spec_ci[1] * 100, spec_ci[2] * 100)
    sensitivity_str <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                               sensitivity * 100, sens_ci[1] * 100, sens_ci[2] * 100)
    
    # 3. Sensitivity for Ct < 30 (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
    ct30_data <- merged_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0) %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0)) %>%
      mutate(SEQ_Result_Adj = case_when(
        Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ SEQ_Result
      ))
    
    TP_ct30 <- sum(ct30_data$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN_ct30 <- sum(ct30_data$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    sensitivity_ct30 <- ifelse((TP_ct30 + FN_ct30) > 0, TP_ct30 / (TP_ct30 + FN_ct30), NA_real_)
    sens_ct30_ci <- calc_clopper_pearson_ci(TP_ct30, TP_ct30 + FN_ct30)
    
    sensitivity_ct30_str <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                                    sensitivity_ct30 * 100, sens_ct30_ci[1] * 100, sens_ct30_ci[2] * 100)
    
    # Store results
    results[[strat]] <- list(
      Reads = reads_stats,
      Specificity = specificity_str,
      Sensitivity = sensitivity_str,
      Sensitivity_Ct30 = sensitivity_ct30_str,
      # Store raw values for debugging
      n_samples = length(strat_samples),
      n_obs = nrow(merged_data),
      TP = TP, FN = FN, FP = FP, TN = TN,
      TP_ct30 = TP_ct30, FN_ct30 = FN_ct30
    )
  }
  
  # Calculate ALL strategies combined
  # Get all samples from all strategies
  all_samples <- strategy_data %>%
    pull(sample_id)
  
  # Combine all datasets to get full data
  all_pcr <- bind_rows(lapply(names(loaded_datasets), function(ds_name) {
    if (ds_name != "ALL_COMBINED") {
      loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]$pcr %>% mutate(Dataset = ds_name)
    }
  }))
  
  all_continuous <- bind_rows(lapply(names(loaded_datasets), function(ds_name) {
    if (ds_name != "ALL_COMBINED") {
      loaded_datasets[[ds_name]]$continuous %>% mutate(Dataset = ds_name)
    }
  }))
  
  # Filter to all samples
  pcr_all <- all_pcr %>% filter(sample_id %in% all_samples)
  cont_all <- all_continuous %>% filter(sample_id %in% all_samples)
  
  # Merge data
  merged_all <- inner_join(pcr_all, cont_all, by = c("sample_id", "Pathogen", "Dataset"))
  
  # 1. Median sequencing depth for ALL (reads per sample)
  reads_all_stats <- "N/A"
  if (file.exists(reads_file)) {
    reads_data <- read_csv(reads_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    if ("fileName" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = fileName)
    }
    if ("totalReads" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(total_reads = totalReads)
    }
    
    if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
      possible_id_cols <- c("sample", "Sample", "SampleID", "sampleID", "id", "ID")
      for (col in possible_id_cols) {
        if (col %in% colnames(reads_data)) {
          reads_data <- reads_data %>% rename(sample_id = all_of(col))
          break
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Filter to all samples
    all_reads <- reads_data %>%
      filter(sample_id %in% all_samples) %>%
      pull(total_reads)
    
    if (length(all_reads) > 0 && !all(is.na(all_reads))) {
      median_reads_all <- median(all_reads, na.rm = TRUE)
      q1_reads_all <- quantile(all_reads, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
      q3_reads_all <- quantile(all_reads, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      reads_all_stats <- sprintf("%.0f (%.0f - %.0f)", 
                                 median_reads_all, q1_reads_all, q3_reads_all)
    }
  }
  
  # 2. Specificity for ALL (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
  seq_all_data <- merged_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result)) %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0)) %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result_Adj = case_when(
      Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ SEQ_Result
    ))
  
  TP_all <- sum(seq_all_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_all_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  TN_all <- sum(seq_all_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_all_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  FP_all <- sum(seq_all_data$PCR_Result == 0 & seq_all_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN_all <- sum(seq_all_data$PCR_Result == 1 & seq_all_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  specificity_all <- ifelse((TN_all + FP_all) > 0, TN_all / (TN_all + FP_all), NA_real_)
  sensitivity_all <- ifelse((TP_all + FN_all) > 0, TP_all / (TP_all + FN_all), NA_real_)
  
  spec_all_ci <- calc_clopper_pearson_ci(TN_all, TN_all + FP_all)
  sens_all_ci <- calc_clopper_pearson_ci(TP_all, TP_all + FN_all)
  
  specificity_all_str <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                                 specificity_all * 100, spec_all_ci[1] * 100, spec_all_ci[2] * 100)
  sensitivity_all_str <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                                 sensitivity_all * 100, sens_all_ci[1] * 100, sens_all_ci[2] * 100)
  
  # 3. Sensitivity for Ct < 30 for ALL (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
  ct30_all_data <- merged_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(PCR_Result), !is.na(ct_values), ct_values < 30, ct_values > 0) %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result = ifelse(coverage_percentage >= 10, 1, 0)) %>%
    mutate(SEQ_Result_Adj = case_when(
      Contam == "YES" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ SEQ_Result
    ))
  
  TP_ct30_all <- sum(ct30_all_data$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_all_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN_ct30_all <- sum(ct30_all_data$PCR_Result == 1 & ct30_all_data$SEQ_Result_Adj == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  sensitivity_ct30_all <- ifelse((TP_ct30_all + FN_ct30_all) > 0, TP_ct30_all / (TP_ct30_all + FN_ct30_all), NA_real_)
  sens_ct30_all_ci <- calc_clopper_pearson_ci(TP_ct30_all, TP_ct30_all + FN_ct30_all)
  
  sensitivity_ct30_all_str <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                                      sensitivity_ct30_all * 100, sens_ct30_all_ci[1] * 100, sens_ct30_all_ci[2] * 100)
  
  # Add ALL results
  results[["ALL"]] <- list(
    Reads = reads_all_stats,
    Specificity = specificity_all_str,
    Sensitivity = sensitivity_all_str,
    Sensitivity_Ct30 = sensitivity_ct30_all_str,
    n_samples = length(all_samples),
    n_obs = nrow(merged_all),
    TP = TP_all, FN = FN_all, FP = FP_all, TN = TN_all,
    TP_ct30 = TP_ct30_all, FN_ct30 = FN_ct30_all
  )
  
  return(results)
}

# Function to display strategy summary table (CONTAMINATION-ADJUSTED)
display_strategy_summary_contam_adj <- function() {
  
  results <- calculate_strategy_metrics_contam_adj()
  
  # Define the order of strategies (matching your example)
  strategy_order <- c("48_P2", "96_P2", "60_P1", "96_P1", "24-V3", "ALL")
  
  # Create table
  table_data <- tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Median sequencing depth, reads per sample (IQR)",
      "Specificity (95% CI)",
      "Sensitivity (95% CI)",
      "Sensitivity for pathogens detected with Ct value <30 (95% CI)"
    )
  )
  
  # Add each strategy in the specified order
  for (strat in strategy_order) {
    if (strat %in% names(results)) {
      table_data[[strat]] <- c(
        results[[strat]]$Reads,
        results[[strat]]$Specificity,
        results[[strat]]$Sensitivity,
        results[[strat]]$Sensitivity_Ct30
      )
    } else {
      table_data[[strat]] <- c("N/A", "N/A", "N/A", "N/A")
    }
  }
  
  return(table_data)
}

# Function to display strategy summary in a formatted kable table
display_strategy_summary_table_contam_adj <- function() {
  
  table_data <- display_strategy_summary_contam_adj()
  
  # Add header row with strategy names and formatting
  kable(table_data, 
        caption = "Performance Metrics by Sequencing Strategy (Contamination-Adjusted)",
        escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "30em") %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#E8E8E8") %>%
    row_spec(nrow(table_data), bold = TRUE, background = "#F0F0F0") %>%  # Bold the ALL row
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Sequencing Strategy" = (ncol(table_data) - 1))) %>%
    print()
}

# Strategy-Based Summary Table (Contamination-Adjusted)

cat("\n### Strategy-Based Performance Summary (Contamination-Adjusted)\n\n")
cat("Performance metrics stratified by sequencing strategy.\n")
cat("**Note:** All metrics calculated using contamination-adjusted results (samples with Contam = YES were set to negative).\n")
cat("**CI:** 95% Clopper-Pearson confidence intervals.\n\n")

display_strategy_summary_table_contam_adj()
```
